Thanks Kim / Lydia. A couple of procurement notes for the vendor record so AP doesn't hit a snag at payment time: 

1) PO policy: Redwood requires a PO number on the invoice for amounts >= $2,500. If an invoice is received without PO, AP will route to the requestor for approval and that delays payment. Please make sure your billing team includes the PO number in the invoice body and filename (PO-12345_invoice.pdf).

2) Remittance parsing: We can accept your proposed remit string, however our system tokenizes on the double-pipe format I think — Kim's suggested exact string (Artemis Supply || INV:%INVOICE% || PO:%PO%) is preferred. If you can set your AP system to emit that formatting (or include it in the invoice footer), matching will be automated.

3) Invoice routing: Please have invoices sent to invoices@redwood.com. If you want to CC an internal Artemis contact, include that address too.

4) Test/micro-deposit: AP usually waits for two micro-deposit amounts to validate an ACH. After micro-deposits clear, we set the payment terms to Net 30 from invoice receipt.

Marissa — I attached a simple CSV mapping template to this message for your records (PO-invoice-mapping-template.csv). Kim, if AP needs an exception for split invoices or split remits, flag it and I will track.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
